name: B10-0387/2026 (PfE) – Evaluation of the Common Fisheries Policy and follow-up
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the evaluation of the Common Fisheries Policy and follow-up
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking for a major rewrite of the EU's fishing rules. It wants food security treated as a top goal, alongside environmental protection. It calls for scrapping the rule that forces fishers to land all their catch, and for looser limits on boat funding so crews can have safer, more modern vessels. It also wants fishers involved in decisions, no new fuel tax on the fleet, and a full reform proposal from the Commission.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's wish list for a future reform of the Common Fisheries Policy.
- **Who it affects:** Fishers, fish farmers, coastal communities, boat owners and consumers across the EU.
- **What happens next:** The Commission is asked to draft a full reform proposal; the Parliament would then debate and vote on it.
